narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage -> List-based: The video uses a cute hook featuring a child, followed by a repetitive montage of various cats eating the product to prove palatability, ending with a detailed feature list and CTA.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specific pet snack (hairball relief paste) by demonstrating that multiple cats enjoy the taste, emphasized by high-energy music and a cute child introduction to build brand trust.
